select tii.* from plm_risk_warning tii
tii.bp_id = #{bpId} and to_char(tii.apply_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

select t.* from (SELECT b.created_by as bp_created_by, p.*, ( SELECT scvb.meaning AS value_name FROM sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb WHERE scb. CODE = 'LON.CONTRACT_WITHDRAW_STATUS' AND scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND scvb.VALUE = p. STATUS ) status_n, (select b.bp_name from hls_bp_master b where b.bp_id = p.bp_id)bp_id_n, (select s.description from sys_user s where s.user_id = p.created_by)created_by_n, (SELECT scvb.meaning AS value_name FROM sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb WHERE scb. CODE = 'RISK WARNING TYPE' AND scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND scvb.VALUE = p.risk_type)risk_type_n FROM plm_risk_warning p,hls_bp_master b where p.bp_id = b.bp_id)t
1=1
and (t.bp_created_by = #{createdBy} or EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user U LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE_B R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE R.ROLE_CODE = 'ADMIN' and U.USER_ID = #{createdBy}))
and t.risk_warning_id = #{riskWarningId}
and t.risk_warning_number = #{riskWarningNumber}
and t.bp_id_n like concat('%',concat(#{bpIdN},'%'))
and t.bp_id in (select ppb.bp_id from prj_project_bp ppb where ppb.project_id = #{projectId} and ppb.bp_type = 'WARRANTOR')
and t.apply_date >= TO_DATE(#{applyDateFrom},'YYYY/MM/DD')
and t.apply_date <= TO_DATE(#{applyDateTo},'YYYY/MM/DD')
order by t.risk_warning_id desc
select rw.* from plm_risk_warning rw where rw.risk_warning_id = #{riskWarningId}
SELECT rw.* FROM plm_risk_warning rw WHERE rw.company_id = #{companyId} AND bp_id = #{bpId} AND rw.is_release_warning = 'N' and rw.data_class='NORMAL'

select nvl(rw.status,'NEW') as status, count(rw.risk_warning_id) as riskWarningCount, count(rw.risk_warning_id)/(select count(risk_warning_id) from plm_risk_warning rrw where rrw.company_id=#{companyId} AND rrw.data_class='NORMAL')*100 as rwCountPercent, (select count(risk_warning_id) from plm_risk_warning rrw where rrw.company_id=#{companyId} AND rrw.data_class='NORMAL') as rwSumCount, (select count(risk_warning_id) from plm_risk_warning rrw where rrw.creation_date > (CURDATE() - DAY (CURDATE()) + 1) and rrw.company_id=#{companyId} AND rrw.data_class='NORMAL') as currentMonthAppend from plm_risk_warning rw WHERE rw.company_id = #{companyId} AND rw.data_class='NORMAL' group by rw.status
